summary: Genius Sports Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the consummation of its acquisition of Zeal Ltd (Legend) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Lion Bidco (Guernsey) Limited. The transaction closed on April 30, 2026, with consideration comprising $800 million in cash (subject to customary adjustments) and 10,088,781 ordinary shares of Genius (issued at a volume-weighted average share price). The Seller Parties are subject to a six-month lock-up on the stock consideration. Additional earn-out consideration may be payable in cash or shares at Genius's election. The acquisition was financed with a new $825 million term loan and $220 million revolving credit facility, secured by substantially all assets. The filing confirms an earn-out and orderly sell-down structure; the regulatory clock has expired as the deal is closed. Watch for integration risk and earn-out triggers.
